guide:
# Reference plugin

## Purpose

This development-only plugin proves the Denote plugin contract and lifecycle. It does not provide a production user feature.

## Enablement and permissions

Enabling requests the Commands permission. The package is downloaded and verified before its code loads.

## Usage

Enable the plugin, then run its reference command from the command palette.

## Settings

This plugin has no settings.

## Disable behavior

Disabling unregisters the command, stops its worker, and deletes the downloaded package. It does not edit or delete vault content.

## Troubleshooting

If activation fails, Denote reports the error, rolls back registrations, terminates the worker, and removes the package.
